source.title: Symphony No. 3, Op. 90 — III. Poco allegretto —
source.encoder: OpenScore Orchestra / Hauptstimme contributors; analytical lyrics omitted from the derivative

method: Licensed symbolic score → LilyPond/MIDI → voice-aware performed event table; tuning estimated with librosa; Sync Toolbox 1.4.2 memory-restricted multiscale DTW at 50 frames/s, chroma + DLNCO. First/last attacks anchored by score-pitch energy rises in documented inspection windows; section anchors refined by DTW and checked against existing passage labels. Note-offs are warped notation, not measured key releases; final written holds extend to an estimated decay threshold. No aural review. See tools/align/REPORT.md.
repeats: Opening eighth-note pickup (bar 0), then bars 1–163 once. Source XML split measures 54/55 and 100/101 are contiguous, not additional rests; LilyPond bar numbering is used.
